paragraphs: In the morning, receive customers, read prescriptions, and measure pupillary distance. Around midday, compare frames and lenses and adjust temples and nose pads. Before delivery, check wearing comfort and revise the fit several times. In the afternoon, fit and maintain contact lenses. Before leaving, organize orders awaiting pickup and after-sales cases.

In short: turn a prescription into comfortable eyewear.
